description:
About the company
 Our client is a technology company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Design and run the shared infrastructure that engineering and review workflows depend on, with a focus on reliability, failure recovery and performance as usage grows. The work spans distributed services, data pipelines and the internal tools that non-engineering specialists use every day.
 What you'll do
 - Build and maintain distributed services and data pipelines that move job execution results and datasets reliably.
 - Diagnose live incidents and tune systems so they use fewer resources, run faster and bounce back after faults.
 - Make long-running jobs that rely on external APIs, remote environments and background services dependable.
 - Build internal tools that reduce repetitive manual work for team members.
 - Set and uphold engineering standards for infrastructure work across the team.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - 3 to 7 years of production software experience.
 - Working familiarity with large-scale software systems that handle heavy traffic and data movement.
 - A track record of taking projects from requirements through implementation and release.
 - Sound engineering judgment and the ability to investigate unfamiliar parts of a codebase.
 - High standards for engineering practice and a high degree of personal agency.
 Bonus points
 - Background in automating AI-driven tasks, serving models in production or building model quality testing tools.
 - Side projects that show initiative and hands-on problem solving.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: $200,000 to $400,000
 - Equity
 - Health, dental and vision coverage
 Location and work model
 - San Francisco, CA, United States
 - On-site, in office
 - Full-time
